import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(data['brand'].unique()))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for i, brand in enumerate(data['brand'].unique()):
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price scatter plot
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['price_usd'], 
                      c=data['model_year'], s=100, alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight (colored by Year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Year')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Max ISO by Brand
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_iso = data.groupby('brand')['max_iso'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax3.barh(brand_iso.index, brand_iso.values, color=colors[:len(brand_iso)])
ax3.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Average Max ISO by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Sensor Type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Body Type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
ax5.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, 
        color=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(body_counts)))
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. 4K Video capability
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_counts = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax6.pie(video_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'])
ax6.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Timeline of releases
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
year_counts = data['model_year'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Models', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Camera Releases Over Time', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Price distribution by brand
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
brands = data['brand'].unique()
prices_by_brand = [data[data['brand'] == brand]['price_usd'].values for brand in brands]
bp = ax8.boxplot(prices_by_brand, labels=brands, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax8.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Price Distribution by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Lens Mount distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
mount_counts = data['lens_mount'].value_counts()
ax9.barh(mount_counts.index, mount_counts.values, 
         color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(mount_counts)))
ax9.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Lens Mount Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
